title: Relative vanishing for the integral twist of a projective graph
statement: Let S be Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth], g:S -> T separated, p:Y -> S proper [def-weil-proper-morphism], N finite, and j:Y -> P(N;T) a closed embedding satisfying j followed by projection = p followed by g [def-nagata-projective-space-base-change]. For L=j^*rho^*O(1) [def-pc-projective-space-twist, def-pc-module-pullback] and injective resolutions of Y.Modules, there is n0 such that every n >= n0 and q>0 has R^q p_*(L tensor-power n)=0.

source.place: Tags 02O5, graph construction of L, and 02O1, Lemma 30.16.2

proof.text: Use the existing proved private helpers AlgebraicGeometry.tensorPullback_invertible and AlgebraicGeometry.homOfGlobalSection_appTop_one from WeilConjectures.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveAmpleInvertible, imported with import all; do not restate either helper. For any finite coordinate type, use the standard coordinate sections of the integral projective twist. Pulling their nonvanishing loci through the tensor-pullback adjunction identifies them with the inverse images of the standard affine charts. These charts cover the source, are affine over an affine base, and form a finite family. Their pulled-back sections, transported through the right unitor, witness ampleness with exponent one. Uniqueness of left adjoints identifies tensor pullback with ordinary pullback. This argument also treats the empty coordinate type, where the cover forces the source empty.

Separatedness of g gives the closed graph lift i = ProjectiveSpace.liftBaseChange p j hj.symm over S. For an affine open V, the morphism-restriction square is cartesian; ProjectiveSpace.isPullback_liftBaseChange identifies the lift iV over V as a base change of i, so it is a closed immersion. Apply the preceding affine projective chart argument to iV. The two liftBaseChange_toProjInt equations identify its composite with the integral projection with the restriction of j followed by the original integral projection. Pullback composition, pullbackCongr and restrictFunctorIsoPullback give an explicit isomorphism to L restricted to p inverse-image V. Transport invertibility and ampleness across it.

Properness over Noetherian S makes Y locally Noetherian. The tensor unit is invertible, quasi-coherent and finitely presented, hence coherent by the locally Noetherian coherence criterion. For each affine V of S apply the independent affine-open twist-vanishing theorem to that unit and L, obtaining a local threshold d(V).

Compactness of S selects finitely many affine opens covering S. Set n0 to the Finset supremum of their thresholds, zero for an empty selection. Every selected restriction vanishes for n >= n0 and q > 0. The proved library theorem Modules.isZero_of_iSup_eq_top glues their vanishing. Map the left unitor of L.tensorPow n through higherDirectImage to remove the unit tensor factor.

proof_origin.note: F4 repaired the three proofs removed by upstream sync e47efb5a5 and restored the commented arbitrary-finite-coordinate helper. The original two proved private helpers are now imported from the source ProjectiveAmpleInvertible module, and nonvanishingLocus_iso is imported from the source AmpleIso module. The graph-restriction argument uses the source projective-space base-change API and an explicit ordinary-pullback composition isomorphism. The structure unit is given its source SheafOfModules.IsInvertible instance with explicit universes before inferring finite type. Existing affine-open twist vanishing and a finite affine cover prove the original unchanged conclusion; no new sorries or nodes.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_isZero_higherDirectImage_graph_twist
    {Y S T : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian S]
    (g : S ⟶ T) [IsSeparated g] (p : Y ⟶ S) [IsProper p]
    (N : Type u) [Finite N] (j : Y ⟶ ℙ(N; T)) [IsClosedImmersion j]
    (hj : j ≫ (ℙ(N; T) ↘ T) = p ≫ g)
    [HasInjectiveResolutions Y.Modules] :
    let L := (pullback j).obj
      ((pullback (ProjectiveSpace.toProjInt N T)).obj
        (Proj.twist (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule N (ULift.{u} ℤ)) 1))
    ∃ n₀ : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, n₀ ≤ n → ∀ q : ℕ, 0 < q →
      IsZero ((higherDirectImage p q).obj (L.tensorPow n))
